architectural-decision-records.why: records the Windows path-normalization fix and the honest test limit
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0056: normalize the pre-push repo root via resolve() so the containment guard does not compare mismatched separators and hollow-pass on Windows
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the fix ships a discriminating test that fails on the buggy code on the affected platform
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added a real-git-repo test: a failing gate must block; on win32 the old code exited 0 so the test goes red, proving the pre-push actually detects now
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change fixes executable logic, so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: a fixture test runs the real hook in a real git repo so it takes the git-toplevel path, not the cwd fallback; the right level for a shell/git hook
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the changed hook; the behavior is pinned as a scenario
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements the fix for the Windows hollow-pass with a discriminating block-on-failure scenario
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the changed line is a path-containment guard that stops arbitrary script execution
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: the fix normalizes the root but preserves the containment guard that rejects a gate path escaping the repo (a tampered manifest must not turn the hook into arbitrary exec); only the separator convention changed
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the test can only discriminate on the affected platform
skeptical-audit.what: documented that the test is discriminating on Windows and a regression check on POSIX, so the Ubuntu CI leg cannot catch a reintroduction, and verified the fix live on Windows
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: ran a fresh-context judge-arch over the normalization fix, the test, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

release-deployment-safety.why: a local hook fix; nothing deployed, migrated, or released

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a one-line normalization in a hook; no architecture change

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or migration

arch-encode.why: a bug fix, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake

universal-browser-device-support.why: a node hook, not browser UI
